summary: Well-structured test suite with strong coverage of all core requirements (age policy, size cap, keep-latest-N, dry-run, error handling). Tests are organized into three layers: unit tests for policy logic (17 passing tests), workflow structure validation, and end-to-end execution through GitHub Actions via act. Good use of fixtures (New-MockArtifact helper, deterministic reference date) and realistic test data (multiple workflows, spanning retention windows). Strengths: comprehensive feature coverage, clear test naming, appropriate isolation, fixture-based integration testing. Minor gaps: edge cases like empty artifact lists, N=0 in keep-latest, future-dated artifacts, and extreme policy values not explicitly tested. Some fragility risk in the act harness (ANSI stripping, output parsing with regex) but complexity is justified by requirements. The powershell-yaml dependency for Workflow.Tests.ps1 is undocumented. Would confidently catch regressions in core logic and CI/CD structure, though some boundary conditions might slip through.
